rubric.evidence: Every load-bearing claim traces to a primary source fetched live 2026-07-29: the chromestatus detail record (deprecate 144 / remove 150 / ~3% page loads / server-side sunset late Dec 2025 / debug-reports bridge), the intent thread (motivation, transitive removal, stub/no-op contingency), the final published spec (normative IDL quoted verbatim; RangeError/TypeError validation semantics extracted from the algorithm text), Chromium IDL at the M149 branch (7820) quoted verbatim, kPrivateAggregationApi FEATURE_ENABLED_BY_DEFAULT + Finch params verified on the M152 branch (7924) features.cc, and the spec repo confirmed archived (last push 2025-12-01). Where source state is ambiguous (trunk enablement after the base feature disappeared from blink/common/features.cc), the page says exactly what was observed without over-claiming.

Slug and folder come from the milestone=152 listing entry (fetched live: category Deprecated, name 'Deprecate and remove: Private Aggregation API', id 4683382919397376). The listing is presented as authoritative for identity while the timeline section documents the earlier deprecate-144/remove-150 plan from the feature notes, including the mismatch between the plan and the observed code state (IDL present at M152 branch and trunk).

The whole removed surface is inventoried in reference-contract.json: interface, 3 methods, 2 dictionaries, and the reporting pipeline, each across all 9 dimensions (2 sourced not-applicable for input-only dictionaries + interface inputs/errors). The overview additionally covers removal rationale, timeline, breakage semantics, migration paths, and specifications. Subtracted one point: runtime behavior post-disablement is source-derived, not executed (local Chrome predates the rollout).

Removal pages live or die on 'what do I do now': the page leads with a removal warn-block, a dedicated what-calling-code-sees-now section (undefined → TypeError, guard pattern), a migration-paths table (third-party cookies, debug-report bridge, no drop-in replacement, Attribution-standard pointer), and a per-stage sunset table separating the already-ended server-side phase from the in-progress client-side phase.

Pre/code examples on every route: historical contributeToHistogram usage with valid contribution, reserved.win on-event usage, enableDebugMode call, dictionary shapes with spec-vs-shipped naming, a full report POST sketch with the wire keys from the spec, and the transition-safe guard. All clearly labelled REMOVED/for-audit. Subtracted one point: examples are spec-derived, not executed against a live build.

No BCD entry (PrivateAggregation.json absent from BCD api/) and zero webstatus results — both verified and stated, with interim tables compiled from the milestone listing, feature notes, and the two vendor standards-position records (Mozilla #805 stale, WebKit #189 withdrawn). Every unknown is explicit.

All citations link primary artifacts directly (spec + anchors, chromestatus record + listing API, intent msgid, Chromium branches 7380/7820/7924/main, both vendor positions, archived spec repo, privacy sandbox status page). The deleted WICG repo is described as deleted with no fake link. Full link sweep still pending (writer's next step).

House-style semantics: single h1 per page, ordered headings (h2-only sections, no skipped levels), scope=row header cells, labelled figures/iframe title, CSS variables only (no raw hex). modern-web-guidance consulted (css-layout retrieved and applied: intrinsic table wrapping via .table-wrap, overflow-wrap for long tokens like .well-known paths).

overflow-wrap:anywhere on h1/lede/inline code (long tokens: contributeToHistogramOnEvent, .well-known paths), tables inside .table-wrap, pre blocks scroll internally. 390px/1280px screenshots to be captured and read before handoff.

CPS route HEAD-checked 200 (2026-07-29) and embedded with lazy iframe + figcaption link on the overview; interface/pipeline pages use text snippets instead (their content is reference, not demo). Iframe render to be verified in the screenshot pass.

guidanceConsulted.query: data table layout responsive reference documentation
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Lean on intrinsic sizing and the browser layout engine; avoid hardcoded dimensions; keep overflow contained.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Tables render inside .table-wrap{overflow-x:auto} with fixed-layout columns and overflow-wrap:anywhere on cells, pre blocks scroll internally, no fixed widths beyond min-width guards.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Semantic structure and readable code blocks without page-level horizontal overflow.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Single h1, ordered h2 sections, scope=row cells, iframe title, pre contained with internal scroll.

Whether retained pre-sunset encrypted payloads have any officially supported final-processing window after late December 2025 is not stated in the feature notes; the page treats them as inert per the notes' wording.
